decisions.reason: Rye country bread builds directly on established baking know-how, allowing the firm to interpret results and improve it, so a drop is unlikely.
As a flagship stollen building on existing expertise and externally confirmed by a gold medal, it strongly fits the firm's absorptive capacity and is very likely to remain.
This rye mixed bread with seeds draws on familiar recipes and processes, enabling the firm to assimilate feedback and continue commercializing it.
Marzipan Christmas stollen is close to the firm's existing stollen offer, so prior knowledge supports assessing and refining the product.
Ancient grain bread, though newer, still builds on existing bread-making capabilities and the firm's ability to learn from early market response supports keeping it.
